# External ontology modules

- `sosa.ttl`: the Sensor, Observation, Sample, and Actuator (SOSA) ontology, the core module of the Semantic Sensor
  Network ontology (W3C Recommendation, October 19, 2017, https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-ssn/). Ontology IRI
  `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/`. Copied on November 22, 2026 from the W3C/OGC Spatial Data on the Web Working Group
  repository, github.com/w3c/sdw, file `ssn/integrated/sosa.ttl`, last changed in commit 6dc6059 (August 10, 2018,
  wording fixes to rdfs:comment and skos:definition after the Recommendation). The workspace could not reach
  w3.org directly. Licence: W3C Software and Document License 2015 and the OGC software licence (stated in the file).
  UKO 15.8 imports this module only, not the full SSN ontology.
